fusions.name: Pelt Shaken Out
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. It deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Weight Behind It
fusions.desc: A heavy sting that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hide Too Thick
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. You have 15% poison resistance.

fusions.name: Slow to Rouse
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a sting strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (272% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
